settings.title: Settings
settings.host_tooltip: Fully qualified domain name of the identity provider. Applications redirect users to this host name for the login.
settings.host_already_used: The host name is already used by another application
settings.host_is_node_fqdn: The host name of the node cannot be used
settings.restrict_admin_console: Admin console from this node only
settings.restrict_admin_console_tooltip: The Keycloak admin console is unreachable from outside. The module keeps managing realms and clients. Disable it to open the console on the host name.
settings.directory_groups_only: Group memberships from the directory only
settings.directory_groups_only_tooltip: Local Keycloak group memberships are ignored. Client access rules on the Access page need this setting.
settings.account_home_redirect: Host root leads to the account page
settings.account_home_redirect_tooltip: The host root opens the account page of the user domain, or a neutral page with several realms. When disabled it leads to the admin console, so also disable the restriction above if you want to reach it from outside.
settings.strict_client_uris_tooltip: Registered applications must use exact HTTPS or native callback addresses, without wildcards. Applies to new registrations.
settings.access_policies_in_use: Remove the client access rules first: they need memberships from the directory only.

access.title: Access
access.description: Restrict the sign-in to an application to the members of one group of its user domain. Only direct members are allowed, and the check runs at every sign-in and token refresh.
access.no_clients_description: Applications appear here after they register with the identity provider.
access.user_domain_not_found: The user domain of this realm was removed
access.access_group_helper: Members of nested groups are not allowed
access.saved_restricted: Only members of {group} can sign in
access.saved_unrestricted: All users of the domain can sign in
access.check_ok: The restriction to {group} is active and LDAP is reachable
access.check_issues: The restriction is incomplete or cannot be checked
access.error_group_not_found: The group does not exist in the user domain.
access.error_ldap_federation_not_found: The realm has no LDAP federation.
access.error_ldap_group_mapper_not_found: The LDAP federation has no read-only group mapper.
access.error_provider_not_installed: The access check provider is not installed in Keycloak.
access.error_protocol_not_supported: Only OpenID Connect applications can be restricted.
access.error_policy_incomplete: The restriction is set, but incomplete: use Check for details.
access.issue_group_not_found: The group is missing in Keycloak: set the restriction again.
access.issue_ldap_federation_not_found: The realm has no LDAP federation.
access.issue_ldap_group_mapper_not_found: The LDAP federation has no read-only group mapper.
access.issue_required_action_disabled: The access check is disabled in the realm.
access.issue_token_gate_missing: The token check of the application is missing.
access.issue_directAccessGrantsEnabled_set: Password grants are enabled for the application.
access.issue_implicitFlowEnabled_set: The implicit flow is enabled for the application.
access.issue_serviceAccountsEnabled_set: Service accounts are enabled for the application.
access.issue_device_grant_set: The device grant is enabled for the application.
access.issue_ciba_grant_set: The CIBA grant is enabled for the application.
access.issue_token_exchange_set: Token exchange is enabled for the application.
access.issue_flow_override_set: The application has its own login flow.
access.issue_ldap_connection_failed: LDAP is not reachable: nobody can sign in.
access.issue_group_not_in_ldap: The group no longer exists in the user domain: nobody can sign in.
access.issue_group_lookup_failed: The group could not be looked up in the user domain.
access.issue_user_check_failed: The user could not be checked.

certificates.confirm_enable: Enable certificate sign-in? It replaces the password/OTP form branch. Review the flow first if multi-factor authentication is required. The IdP address is unreachable for a few seconds.
certificates.title: Certificates
certificates.description: Optional passwordless sign-in using a personal device certificate. Enroll only the public PEM certificate; keep its private key on the device. Requires the NS8 Traefik client-certificate extension. Existing application access groups still apply.
certificates.no_realms: Create a user domain realm first.
certificates.revoke_notice: Revoking a certificate also signs this user out of all IdP sessions. Existing application sessions and offline data have their own lifetime.
certificates.label: Device name
certificates.confirm_revoke: Revoke {label} and end all IdP sessions of this user?
certificates.error_invalid_certificate: Select one public PEM certificate without a private key.
certificates.error_invalid_client_certificate: A valid client authentication certificate is required.
certificates.error_certificate_not_current: Certificate expired or not yet valid.
certificates.error_ldap_identity_missing: The LDAP identity could not be verified.
certificates.error_certificate_limit: Maximum of 128 certificates per realm reached.
certificates.error_custom_browser_flow: The custom browser authentication flow must be reviewed first.
certificates.error_traefik_certificate_support_requir: Install the NS8 Traefik client-certificate extension before enabling this feature.
certificates.not_operational: Enabled but not effective right now: the proxy reports no client certificates or the sign-in flow was changed. Password sign-in still works.
certificates.revocation_pending: revocation incomplete, sign-in denied; run revoke again
certificates.error_invalid_proxy_secret: The internal proxy proof of the module is invalid.
certificates.error_traefik_route_failed: The proxy routes could not be changed; the previous routes were restored.
certificates.error_idp_route_missing: The IdP route cannot be read. Reconfigure the module and try again.
